news.title: Maritime Domain Awareness Market and Capability Assessments for the Department of Homeland Security
news.summary_en: To help the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) improve maritime domain awareness (MDA), the authors assess commercial technologies and DHS components’ capabilities, and they provide recommendations for optimizing DHS’s MDA capabilities.

news.title: Will Teens Just Stay Up Later If School Starts Later? California Says No.
news.summary_en: Every time a school district considers a later start time, the same objection surfaces: teens will just stay up later. It's an understandable worry. But now we have national data that suggest otherwise.

news.title: Care Forward Colorado and Career Advance Colorado: Financial Aid Programs to Support Workforce Credentialing in High-Demand Fields
news.summary_en: The authors evaluate the implementation and impacts of two Colorado financial aid programs: Care Forward and Career Advance. These programs provided financial support to individuals pursuing certificates and associates degrees in high-demand fields.

news.title: If AI Takes the Jobs, Who Will Pay the Taxes?
news.summary_en: This research brief describes the fiscal implications for federal revenue in scenarios in which artificial intelligence and automation technologies replace human labor and summarizes policy options to stabilize the tax base.

news.title: Supply Chain Vulnerabilities May Worsen Critical Electrical Equipment Bottlenecks, Further Delaying the U.S. Ability to Power AI Energy Expansion
news.summary_en: Researchers examined how supply chain vulnerabilities could affect the equipment needed to power frontier artificial intelligence (AI) data centers and, in turn, the U.S. power system’s ability to meet AI demand by 2030.
